name: untyped-raw
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id

name: untyped-raw-throwing-projection
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN substring(n.callee_name,'bad') AS failure

name: untyped-wrapped
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id

name: untyped-wrapped-throwing-projection
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN substring(n.callee_name,'bad') AS failure

name: typed-raw
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id

name: typed-raw-throwing-projection
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN substring(n.callee_name,'bad') AS failure

name: typed-wrapped
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id

name: typed-wrapped-throwing-projection
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN substring(n.callee_name,'bad') AS failure

name: fourfields-raw-distinct-limit
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_class CONTAINS 'other' OR n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' OR n.callee_class CONTAINS 'other' OR n.callee_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller_class,n.caller_name AS caller_name,n.callee_class AS callee_class,n.callee_name AS callee_name LIMIT 1000

name: fourfields-wrapped-distinct-limit
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_class,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.callee_class,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.callee_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller_class,n.caller_name AS caller_name,n.callee_class AS callee_class,n.callee_name AS callee_name LIMIT 1000
